index_record.dataset_generation_caption:
The figure presents an overview of the SpeechSSM architecture, which consists of two main components: a causal hybrid state-space model (Griffin) for semantic token modeling on the left, and a non-autoregressive synthesizer (SoundStorm) for speaker-conditioned acoustic token generation on the right. The global layout is linear and left-to-right, depicting a complete pipeline from raw audio input to reconstructed audio output.

On the far left, a waveform representation of raw audio is shown, followed by a 'Windowing' step indicated by a gray arrow pointing to a trapezoidal-shaped module labeled 'USM-v2 Encoder'. This encoder processes the audio into discrete semantic representations. The output of the encoder is passed through a gray rectangular block labeled 'VQ', representing vector quantization, which produces a sequence of USM-v2 Tokens. These tokens are visualized as a vertical stack of orange circles numbered 0, 1, 2, ..., t-1, indicating a time-series sequence.

The central component is a large rounded rectangle labeled 'SpeechSSM', outlined in light orange. Inside, the process begins with an 'Embedder' (orange rectangle), which maps the incoming tokens into a latent space. This is followed by a series of processing blocks enclosed in a dashed orange border, repeated N times. Each iteration contains two 'Recurrent Residual Block' modules (orange rectangles) followed by a 'Local Attention Residual Block' (also orange). The sequence ends with another 'Embedder' module, which outputs a new sequence of USM-v2 Tokens, now indexed from 1 to t, indicating a shifted or updated token sequence.

To the right of the SpeechSSM module, the output tokens undergo another 'Windowing' step, represented by a gray arrow leading to a blue rounded rectangle labeled 'SoundStorm'. Below this module, three red circles are labeled 'Speaker Reference', indicating that SoundStorm is conditioned on speaker identity. The output of SoundStorm is a grid of blue and light-blue circular tokens labeled 'SoundStream Tokens', arranged in a 3x4 matrix, representing the acoustic codebook tokens generated by the neural codec.

Finally, these acoustic tokens are fed into a trapezoidal-shaped 'SoundStream Decoder' module, which reconstructs the original audio waveform, shown as a waveform on the far right, completing the end-to-end pipeline. All connections between modules are indicated by gray arrows, showing the direction of data flow. The figure uses distinct colors and shapes to differentiate components: gray for preprocessing/decoding modules, orange for the SpeechSSM internal blocks, and blue for the SoundStorm and its output tokens. Text labels are placed adjacent to each module for clarity.
